audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill for levels 1-6 while the content layer and the packet both read Karma for levels 1-4 and Azir from 5 on. Two layers, two answers to the same row.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range on a 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown for 40-80 mana; Azir's Q is 740 range, 14s at rank 1, and costs 70-110. She wins the early poke war on range, cooldown and mana. Azir's edge starts at Emperor's Divide and compounds at Nashor's. Win rate 46.05% over 1127 games agrees.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side set to Karma (rating 4/10), phases[4].side set to Azir. Content win[] already reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Azir/Azir/Azir, so the pair now agrees rather than contradicting; every moved row's why was rewritten in the same proposal to match the new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and breakdown/content mid both named Azir's ultimate 'Shurima's Legacy'. That ability does not exist.
audit.why: Azir's R is Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s, 250 range) — a knockback wall. Shurima's Legacy is not in Riot's kit data.
audit.corrected: Emperor's Divide used throughout; the level 6 spike now states what the wall actually does — it knocks Karma out of her own 675-range Focused Resolve tether.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it is not broken, and Azir's Shifting Sands is the tool that breaks it. breakdown.cooldowns also contained no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Karma W is a flat 12s at all ranks, 675 range, and roots only if the tether survives; Azir E is a 1100-range dash on 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s. Karma's Mantra'd W heals her and extends the root — that is the anti-heal trigger flagged in missingInteractions. Mantra itself is 40/38/36/34s and its cooldown is reduced by her damaging abilities (Gathering Fire).
audit.corrected: Cooldown field now carries the real numbers (W 12s flat, Q 9s down to 5s, E 16-22s) and the Do's bullet explains that dashing outside 675 fizzles the tether. Grievous Wounds is called for before extended trades once she is ahead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty lint findings, mostly MISGENDER — Karma is female and was called he/his/him across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, two phase whys, wave, trading, three Do's, one Don't and five report entries. Two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets (dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim).
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists karma as female; the bled bullets promise one thing in the title and explain another in the body.
audit.corrected: All in-scope pronouns fixed and both bled bullets replaced with content that matches their titles.
